about_the_game: Place your favorite characters on your desktop! This is a desktop idle companion game designed for work, study, and entertainment. Here, you can summon various fun desktop buddies who will not only keep you company during busy times but also boost your productivity—whether it's venting emotions, collecting characters, or quickly launching productivity tools (like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists). With personalized companions and practical features, make every day of work and study more relaxed and enjoyable!

short_description: Place your favorite characters on your desktop! A desktop idle game for work, study, and fun. Summon cute companions to keep you company, vent stress, or collect characters. Quickly access productivity tools like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists—making your desktop lively and efficient!
